|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Depa Billaba (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V7-L-depabillaba-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-depabillaba022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/depabillaba.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/depabillaba.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Depa Billaba”. Text: “If at least two [Light Side] icons here, once during your control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck. If at least two [Dark Side] icons here, may forfeit in place of your hit non-Jedi character present with Depa (forfeit = 0), restoring that character to normal.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Depa Billaba (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-depabillabaa57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/depabillaba.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/depabillaba.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' “Depa (forfeit = 0), restoring” → “Depa (forfeit for 0), restoring”; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•Depa Billaba” → “Depa Billaba” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Depa Billaba”.
